# R1: Data download, preparation and audit

<img src="../assets/statsbomb_logo.png" alt="Hudl StatsBomb logo" width="220">

*Generated by `python -m recruit.run_r1` from `results/r1_data_report.json`. Do not edit the numbers
by hand.*

Data: StatsBomb Open Data (github.com/hudl/open-data), used under the StatsBomb Public Data User
Agreement; market values from transfermarkt-datasets (CC0-1.0, built by its maintainer from
Transfermarkt). StatsBomb logo from the StatsBomb Media Pack (statsbomb.com/media-pack), unchanged.
This page shows only counts and summaries, never event-level data.

## What this step does, in plain words

R1 gets the data ready. It downloads every match of the 2015/16 season (StatsBomb season
27) for the four leagues, plus the Transfermarkt-derived player, club, appearance and
market-value tables. Each raw file is fingerprinted, so any later change to a file stops the pipeline.
The match files are then cut down, one match at a time, to the columns later steps need and saved as
compact parquet files, and everything is loaded into a DuckDB database with fixed column types.
Finally four checks ("gates") decide whether the data can support the project.

| Gate | What it asks | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 1. Market values | Do league players have a valuation close to 2016-07-01? | **PASS** |
| 2. Pressures | Are pressure events recorded in all four leagues? | **PASS** |
| 3. Lineup times | Do lineup positions carry start and end times (needed for minutes played)? | **PASS** |
| 4. Size and memory | How big is the data and does preparing it fit an 8 GB laptop? | **PASS** |

example a doubled apostrophe); later steps use the StatsBomb id, not the name.

## Gate 1: market values around 2016-07-01

Who counts: every player with a Transfermarkt appearance in one of the four leagues during the
2015/16 season window. This list comes from the appearances table, not from the valuations, so the
check is not circular. A price may only use a valuation from on or before 2016-07-01 (no
hindsight), so the gate is judged on the "6 months before" column. No valuation dated after
2016-07-01 is read or counted. The line to clear is 80.0% (config/audit.yaml), and
the departing player must have a usable valuation.

| League (Transfermarkt code) | Players | Valued in 6 months before | Share |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| ES1 | 538 | 505 | 93.9% |
| FR1 | 575 | 558 | 97.0% |
| GB1 | 549 | 512 | 93.3% |
| IT1 | 551 | 534 | 96.9% |
| All four | 2,175 | 2,072 | 95.3% |

The departing player's valuation history in the 12 months up to the date (nothing later is
listed):

| Date | Market value (EUR) | Club on the record | Days before 2016-07-01 |
|---|---:|---|---:|
| 2015-10-14 | 7,000,000 | Leicester City | 261 |
| 2016-02-09 | 10,000,000 | Leicester City | 143 |
| 2016-06-01 | 20,000,000 | Leicester City | 30 |

The usable price for the departing player is the latest valuation on or before the date inside the
window: 20,000,000 EUR on
2016-06-01
(30 days before).

## Gate 3: lineup positions with start and end times

56,884 position spells in total; 56,884 have a start
time (100.0%; the line is 99.0%),
23,493 have an end time. 1,517 of
1,517 matches have position spells for both teams; each team used between
11 and 14 players
per match. A spell with no end time means the player stayed on to the end:

| End reason | Stints |
|---|---:|
| Final Whistle | 33,391 |
